mapper.sql: select t1.*, t3.name classroom, t4.name teacher_name, t7.course_name, t8.name grade_name, ( SELECT count( 0 ) FROM class_student t0 WHERE t0.class_id = t1.id and t0.deleted = 0 ) student_count, ( SELECT count( 0 ) FROM lesson t8 WHERE t8.class_id = t1.id and t8.date <= CURDATE() and t8.end_time < CURTIME()) over_lesson_count, ( SELECT count( 0 ) FROM lesson t8 WHERE t8.class_id = t1.id) schedule_lesson_count, ( SELECT t10.subject_name FROM edu_subject t10 WHERE t10.id = t7.subject_id ) AS subject_name from class t1 LEFT JOIN classroom t3 on t3.id = t1.classroom_id LEFT JOIN edu_teacher t4 ON t4.id = t1.teacher_id LEFT JOIN edu_course t7 ON t7.id = t1.course_id LEFT JOIN class_grade t8 ON t8.id = t1.grade_id
mapper.select: select t1.* from class t1 left join class_student t2 on t2.class_id = t1.id where t1.course_id = #{courseId} and t2.student_id = #{studentId} and t1.be_over = 0 and t1.end_date > CURDATE() group by t1.id order by t1.end_date desc limit 1
